{"title": "[Nimbus Ledger] Publish-path quota exhaustion on northeu topic ledger-events-primary caused by mis-merged config PR #4429", "summary": "Incident 999000002 tracks a publish-path outage on the Nimbus Ledger northeu region.

Symptom: NLX-3301 (publish quota exceeded) climbed from ~1/s baseline to ~200/s starting 09:14 UTC. Publishers on topic ledger-events-primary experienced backpressure and, in a smaller number of cases, dropped messages after their local retry budgets were exhausted.

Root cause was isolated during the same session and is recorded on this ticket.

See dashboard: https://dashboards.nimbus-ledger.example.com/incident/999000002
Runbook: https://runbooks.nimbus-ledger.example.net/quota-refill

Related work items:
  - Work item 9990000034: manual config sync recovering the primary topic refill rate.
  - Work item 9990000037: second manual sync recovering the audit-trail topic refill rate.
  - Work item 9990000041: schema validator rejecting refill_rate=0 without an explicit deprecation flag.
  - Work item 9990000042: config-review approval gate on topics/prod/*.yaml PRs.
", "communications": [{"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Incident 999000002 created via automated correlation. Owning team: nl-publish-primary. Primary signal: error NLX-3301 on component quota-broker.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Incident 999000002 routed to team nl-publish-primary by policy rule NL-ROUTING-14.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-oncall-02", "Text": "Publish rate on northeu topic-registry dropped ~40% at 09:14 UTC. NLX-3301 (publish quota exceeded) climbed from ~1/s baseline to ~200/s. No deploys in the last 12h per the deploy log. Looking at quota-broker.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 2h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-dev-21", "Text": "@nl-oncall-02 quota-broker is reporting zero refills for topic ledger-events-primary since 09:00 UTC. Every other topic is refilling normally. So this isn't a broker-wide outage, it's per-topic. Something specific to that topic's quota row.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-dev-21", "Text": "Hit the quota-broker admin API on quota-01.northeu.nimbus-ledger.example.net directly. topic=ledger-events-primary refill_rate is 0. Config-db snapshot from an hour ago has it at 5000/s. Something zeroed it in the last hour. Checking the audit log.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-dev-21", "Text": "Audit log: the quota row for ledger-events-primary was written at 08:57:04 UTC by service account nl-config-sync-bot. That's the scheduled config sync. So the config db already had refill_rate=0 for that row when the sync ran. The bot did what it was told.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 3h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-arch-41", "Text": "Hold on. Config db is supposed to be immutable at rest during ops hours. Either that assumption is wrong or the sync bot pulled the wrong file. Want to see what the sync bot actually read before we accept Sana's audit-log story.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-oncall-04", "Text": "sync bot log:
```
[08:57:04.101] pulling s3://nl-config/topics/prod/northeu.yaml
[08:57:04.334] parsed 2141 rows
[08:57:05.012] applied 2141 rows OK
```
file size 412KB. can diff s3 against 24h ago.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 1h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-dev-21", "Text": "Diffed the s3 object against 24h ago. The relevant hunk in topics/prod/northeu.yaml:
```
topics:
   ledger-events-primary:
-    refill_rate: 5000
+    refill_rate: 0
     burst: 20000
     window_ms: 1000
     hot_partitions:
       - shard-07
       - shard-11
       - shard-24
     backpressure_policy: reject-newest
     alert_owner: nl-publish-primary
```
PR #4429 in the nl-config/topics-prod repo. Title: 'ledger-events-primary: align refill schedule with onboarding-tooling test harness'. Body (paraphrased):
---
Onboarding tooling test harness uses a mocked broker that returns quota-denied on refill_rate=0 for the primary topic to simulate backpressure paths. Setting refill_rate to 0 in the shared config lets the harness exercise the same code path against the real broker during CI dry runs. Will be reverted before nightly promotion.
---
Committed by rowan.boateng@example.com at 08:52 UTC. Approved by one reviewer (auto-approved by nl-onboarding-tooling-approver). NOT approved by nl-config-review, which is supposed to be a required reviewer on topics/prod/*.yaml — the CODEOWNERS entry that should have enforced that was pinned to a stale team ID. Filed a follow-up on the CODEOWNERS drift as work item 9990000039.
Note: the PR body's 'reverted before nightly promotion' language was aspirational, not enforced. The promotion job ran at 08:57 UTC, five minutes after merge.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-arch-41", "Text": "so this is not an infra bug. this is a mis-merged PR.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 2h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-oncall-02", "Text": "Reverting PR #4429 and re-running the config sync manually with the previous YAML. Manual sync tracked as work item 9990000034. Reverting first, verifying broker second, then unblocking publishers.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 1h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 4h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-sre-11", "Text": "Manual sync ran at 10:22 UTC. quota-broker shows refill_rate=5000 for ledger-events-primary. NLX-3301 rate on northeu is down to ~3/s and dropping. Publishers with backpressure are draining. Not baseline yet — the retry queue is still working through its backlog.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 2h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-arch-41", "Text": "@nl-oncall-02 heads up: PR #4429 touched two other rows I saw in the diff before it got closed. northeu-audit-trail went from refill_rate=800 to 100. That's most likely the source of the trickle of NLX-3301 we're still seeing on that topic.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-dev-22", "Text": "PR #4432 restores northeu-audit-trail to refill_rate=800 and adds a schema comment on both rows so this doesn't happen again quietly. Running the config sync a second time to pick it up. Second sync tracked as work item 9990000037.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Status changed to Investigating by policy engine.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-mgr-31", "Text": "Second sync at 11:04 UTC. NLX-3301 rate on northeu at ~1/s baseline. Publish rate on ledger-events-primary and northeu-audit-trail recovered to normal. Marking mitigated.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 3h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 6h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 9h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 11h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 14h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 16h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 18h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 20h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 23h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "SLA reminder: incident 999000002 approaching 24h unmitigated threshold. Please update status.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Status changed to Active by policy engine.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 31h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 34h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Periodic notification: incident 999000002 still open. Time since last human update: 36h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-arch-42", "Text": "Picking this back up. Overnight was quiet on the ticket — the page never re-fired — but NLX-3301 came back on northeu at 12:11 UTC (day 2 of the incident). Low rate but real. ledger-events-primary again. Broker refill_rate is still 5000, so the config side hasn't regressed. Reading the metrics: the retry queue that sits in front of the broker is still draining backpressure from yesterday's stall and periodically punches through the 20000 burst boundary. Watching, don't think we need to intervene.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-arch-41", "Text": "12:47 UTC (day 2) — retry queue drained. NLX-3301 back to 0/s baseline on northeu. Confirmed root cause: PR #4429 (onboarding-tooling change) zeroed refill_rate on two topics in topics/prod/northeu.yaml. The scheduled config sync then propagated the zero to the quota broker. Merged without required config-review approval.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-oncall-02", "Text": "First-line triage — pulled the platform-wide regional health dashboard https://dashboards.nimbus-ledger.example.com/platform/regional-health to check whether any peer team is seeing correlated signal. Nothing anomalous outside our own NLX-3301 trace.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-oncall-02", "Text": "Ran the platform-wide incident-events cross-region query:
```
nl_incident_events
| where TIMESTAMP > ago(24h)
| summarize count() by region, err_code
```
only our own err_code shows up in the top-10. no cross-team correlation.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-oncall-02", "Text": "Closing. Root cause recorded on this ticket. Follow-ups: (1) work item 9990000041 adds a validator that rejects refill_rate=0 in topics/prod/*.yaml without an explicit deprecation flag; (2) work item 9990000042 requires config-review approval on any PR touching topics/prod/*.yaml before it can merge.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Post-resolution monitoring: incident 999000002 in observation window. Hours since resolution: 4h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Status changed to Resolved by policy engine.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Post-resolution monitoring: incident 999000002 in observation window. Hours since resolution: 9h.
SCREENSHOTS:"}, {"ChangedBy": "nl-bot-sre", "Text": "Status changed to Closed by policy engine.
SCREENSHOTS:"}], "root_cause": [{"RootCauseId": 8842001, "RootCauseId1": 8842019, "Category": "Configuration", "SubCategory": "", "IsCausedByChange": true, "Description": "Mis-merged PR #4429 zeroed refill_rate on two topics/prod/northeu.yaml rows; propagated to broker."}], "tsg": ""}

metadata.title: [Nimbus Ledger] Publish-path quota exhaustion on northeu topic ledger-events-primary caused by mis-merged config PR #4429
